description:
Buys the single package or one of the three plans, with credit or x402, also without an account.
Without payment, it returns 402 with the price in dollars and reais. The body uses x402 v1; PAYMENT-REQUIRED uses v2. With an account or credit, the balance stays with that holder. Without identification, it stays with the wallet that the x402 payment confirmed. To use this balance, sign the wallet challenge and get the mmw_… credential at the wallet_start and wallet_token URLs of the answer. The payment does not grant a login or access to the linked account. A plan adds 30 days and the quota; a package is valid for 90 days. No automatic renewal.

compra.description: Mark of this purchase (8 to 64 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-`): with credit, repeating with the same mark does not charge again. With x402, do not sign another payment to repeat the same purchase.

credit_token.description: Prepaid credit token (`cred_…`) that pays for the purchase.

payment.description: Signed x402 payment, from the 402 quote.
